id: title:jonmcwest:store signed internal log batches outside billing

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration, counters, and a verifier to distinguish and account for internal, signed, unbilled log ingestion, potentially supporting billing exemption and capacity planning.
review.reason: The chunk includes configuration defaults, a new metric counter, and implementation checks for distinguishing internal, signed, unbilled logs. This establishes the runtime behavior and accounting separation required for the billing bypass, supporting a tier 2 assessment. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 maintenance-only behavior is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the referenced helper methods or the complete definition of the InternalLogs type, and lacks production configuration and release notes, so the full correctness and completeness of the billing and filtering behavior cannot be independently verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the ingestion consumer, the warehouse-side ingestion, or the database migration. It also does not include the configuration or deployment changes. Therefore, while the configuration and test changes are clear, the actual runtime behavior and its effect on PostHog cannot be established. No score is assigned.
